entries.title: Sonate I, I - Allegro con brio
Ases Tod
entries.sourceNotes: This Piano piece's main source was from the Kunkel Brothers 1891, reprinted in 1893. Many of the slurs and fingerings were extremely excessive (and unnecessary), and so, were omitted. Many of the dynamics and (de)crescendi were left as entered to help reduce file size and make the sheetmusic (and file) less busy. If you are interested in the fingering for this piece, please email your request to the address @maintainerEmail. Karmically, Deborah.
